news.title: Patch Notes — v0.5.0
news.shortDescription: Hardcore mode is here — no checkpoints, no safety net. Plus a dedicated leaderboard tab and various improvements.
news.fullBody:
Hardcore mode is here. Not for the faint of heart.

NEW CONTENT
- Added Hardcore mode — no checkpoints, no safety net. Built for the most patient and skilled players who want to push their limits
- Added a dedicated Hardcore leaderboard tab — players who complete Hardcore are displayed separately in their own exclusive section

NEW & REWORKED FEATURES
- SteamOS users will now see the system's native virtual keyboard instead of the legacy keyboard

BUG FIXES
- Fixed a bug that prevented the back button from being clickable while in menus
- Fixed a bug that prevented the leaderboard panel from opening on the first click
- Fixed various minor bugs and fine-tuned various details

IMPROVEMENTS
- Lobby system improvements
- General UI improvements and adjustments based on player usage patterns
- Various improvements for Steam Deck users
- Added new sounds

KNOWN ISSUES (we're actively working on these)
- Some AMD GPU users may experience very low FPS due to a driver-level issue affecting AMD Radeon cards. Updating your drivers resolves it in most cases.
- On lower-end PCs, the map may fail to load or load incompletely. We are actively investigating this.

Have a bug to report, a suggestion, or something you'd like to see in the game? Leave a review, use the in-game feedback button, or reach us on Discord. We read everything and do our best to make it happen.

— DVS Interactive

news.title: Guinea Pig Runaway Together Supporter Pack
news.shortDescription: Support the development and get exclusive in-game goodies with the Guinea Pig Runaway Together Support Pack.
news.fullBody:
Want to help us keep rolling?

The Guinea Pig Runaway Together Support Pack is now available. It includes exclusive cosmetic items and shows your support for an indie team of three working hard to make the best guinea pig co-op experience possible.

Every purchase goes directly back into development. Thank you for being part of this journey.

news.title: Vegawon's Legacy — Wishlist Now on Steam
news.shortDescription: A new adventure from DWS Interactive. Wishlist Vegawon's Legacy on Steam!
news.fullBody:
While we keep rolling with Guinea Pig Runaway Together, we also have something else brewing.

Vegawon's Legacy is a separate project from DWS Interactive. We are not going anywhere Guinea Pig Runaway Together development continues as planned.

If you are curious, head over to the Steam page and add it to your wishlist. It means a lot to us.
